risk_assessment.mitigation: Limit exposure to affected equities (e.g., Canadian resource stocks) and monitor currency hedges
Maintain diversified portfolios, use options or sector rotation to manage volatility

risk_assessment.risk_factor: AI hype bust & tech valuation correction
risk_assessment.mitigation: Reduce overweight in high‑beta AI/semiconductor stocks, increase cash or defensive holdings
Avoid highly leveraged data‑center REITs; consider quality tenants with long‑term contracts
Use commodity‑linked ETFs for exposure; hedge with futures if appropriate

opportunities.recommendation: Take selective long positions in copper exposure as Asian demand outpaces Chinese supply
opportunities.rationale: Supply crunch signals upward pressure on prices; aligns with bullish fundamentals

opportunities.recommendation: Allocate to oil & integrated energy stocks anticipating continued sub‑$100 price support
opportunities.rationale: Geopolitical de‑escalation and demand recovery create a floor; dividend yields add income

opportunities.recommendation: Add exposure to travel & hospitality leaders benefiting from post‑pandemic demand rebound
opportunities.rationale: Airbnb’s 12% surge reflects strong booking growth and pricing power

opportunities.recommendation: Consider selective AI‑related equities with strong balance sheets despite market skepticism
opportunities.rationale: Large funding round indicates confidence; focus on companies with diversified revenue

defensive_moves.recommendation: Trim exposure to data‑center REITs and high‑beta tech stocks
defensive_moves.rationale: Credit concerns and AI valuation pressure increase downside risk

defensive_moves.recommendation: Increase allocation to gold or gold‑linked instruments as a hedge against inflation and market stress
defensive_moves.rationale: Gold’s price drop may be temporary; safe‑haven demand could rebound on tighter labor data

defensive_moves.recommendation: Diversify into defensive consumer staples and healthcare to buffer election‑driven volatility
defensive_moves.rationale: These sectors historically show resilience during political uncertainty

market_outlook.short_term: 1‑3 months: Elevated volatility as midterm election outcomes settle and AI valuation corrections continue. Expect tech indices to underperform, while energy and commodity‑linked assets may see modest upside.
market_outlook.long_term: 6‑12 months: Potential stabilization of tech valuations if AI products mature; gradual recovery in global growth supporting copper and industrial metals; oil price trajectory tied to geopolitical developments. Overall market likely to trend neutral to mildly positive pending policy clarity.
key_catalysts: US midterm election results and subsequent fiscal/legislative actions
China’s copper supply response and industrial demand data
Oil supply dynamics and any escalation/de‑escalation of Iran conflict
Regulatory developments around AI and crypto reporting (FinCEN withdrawal)
Corporate earnings cycles (e.g., Q3 results for tech and energy firms)
